general.title: General
general.description: Configure instance-wide preferences including log display, keyboard shortcuts, backup retention, and data sharing.

deployment.title: Deployment and auth
deployment.localTrusted: Local trusted mode is optimized for a local operator. Browser requests run as local board context and no sign-in is required.
deployment.authenticatedPublic: Authenticated public mode requires sign-in for board access and is intended for public URLs.
deployment.authenticatedPrivate: Authenticated private mode requires sign-in and is intended for LAN, VPN, or other private-network deployments.

censorUsername.title: Censor username in logs
censorUsername.description: Hide the username segment in home-directory paths and similar operator-visible log output. Standalone username mentions outside of paths are not yet masked in the live transcript view. This is off by default.

keyboardShortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
keyboardShortcuts.description: Enable app keyboard shortcuts, including inbox navigation and global shortcuts like creating issues or toggling panels. This is off by default.

backupRetention.title: Backup retention
backupRetention.description: Configure how long automatic database backups are retained. Backups run roughly every hour and are compressed with gzip. Within the daily window all backups are kept; beyond that, one backup per week and one per month are preserved.

feedbackSharing.title: AI feedback sharing
feedbackSharing.description: Control whether thumbs up and thumbs down votes can send the voted AI output to Paperclip Labs. Votes are always saved locally.
feedbackSharing.promptNotice: No default is saved yet. The next thumbs up or thumbs down choice will ask once and then save the answer here.
feedbackSharing.notAllowedDescription: Keep voted AI outputs local only.
feedbackSharing.retestHintBefore: To retest the first-use prompt in local dev, remove the
feedbackSharing.retestHintAfter: JSON row for this instance, or set it back to
feedbackSharing.retestHintFinal: both mean no default has been chosen yet.

environments.title: Enable Environments
environments.description: Show environment management in company settings and allow project and agent environment assignment controls.

isolatedWorkspaces.title: Enable Isolated Workspaces
isolatedWorkspaces.description: Show execution workspace controls in project configuration and allow isolated workspace behavior for new and existing issue runs.

autoRestart.title: Auto-Restart Dev Server When Idle
autoRestart.description: In `pnpm dev:once`, wait for all queued and running local agent runs to finish, then restart the server automatically when backend changes or migrations make the current boot stale.

autoRecovery.title: Auto-Create Issue Recovery Tasks
autoRecovery.description: Let the heartbeat scheduler create recovery issues for issue dependency chains found inside the configured lookback window.

signingModeDesc.bearer: Expect a shared bearer token in the Authorization header.

concurrencyDesc.coalesce_if_active: Keep one follow-up run queued while an active run is still working.
concurrencyDesc.always_enqueue: Queue every trigger occurrence, even if several runs stack up.
concurrencyDesc.skip_if_active: Drop overlapping trigger occurrences while the routine is already active.

catchUpDesc.skip_missed: Ignore schedule windows that were missed while the routine or scheduler was paused.
catchUpDesc.enqueue_missed_with_cap: Catch up missed schedule windows in capped batches after recovery.
